description: Invented-name convention for the synthetic project and vendor roster. Expressed as patterns a check applies mechanically, so conformance is enforced rather than reviewed.

projects.name_pattern: ^(Thundervale|Kestrelmoor|Ashgrove Hollow|Pellmire|Quillhaven) (Transit Interchange|Water Reclamation Plant|Civic Archive|Regional Hospital|Freight Terminal)$
projects.rule: A fabricated placename drawn from the approved list, followed by a facility type. Placenames are invented compounds that return no real municipality.

vendors.rule: An invented compound stem carrying one of the approved fictional suffixes, followed by a trade-descriptive noun. The stem suffixes are chosen because no operating construction supplier uses them.
